definitions: A feature on certain mobile devices that allows users to initiate a search by circling, highlighting, or scribbling on an image or text on their screen.
A gesture-based search function integrated into a device's operating system, enabling direct content inquiry from any screen.
examples: He used Circle to Search to identify the landmark in the photo.
Circle to Search makes it easier to get information without switching apps.
The new phone's standout feature is Circle to Search.
